monospace.usage: Prices, ticker symbols, data points, risk disclosure

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-medium tracking-tighter text-[#0B1021]
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0B1021]
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#0B1021]/60

visual_enhancers.textures: Use soft noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to enhance the 'paper/editorial' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-[#0B1021]/10 for cards and dividers. No heavy drop shadows. Rely on structural grid lines.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp corners or very minimal rounded corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Avoid pill-shaped buttons except for specific call-outs; stick to sharp, editorial rectangles.

layouts.grid_system: Swiss grid. 12-column foundation. Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12, p-24).
layouts.bento_grid: For 'Why One Stock Academy' and 'Courses', use architectural bento layouts with 1px borders dividing the sections.
layouts.spacing: Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Negative space is a primary design tool here.

motion.ticker_tape: Use react-fast-marquee for the continuous financial ticker. Monospace font, uppercase, separated by distinct dots or arrows. Subtle opacity so it doesn't overpower the hero.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for text elements. Framer Motion for the animated candlestick chart in the hero (bars growing, wicks extending).
motion.hover_states: Buttons have a subtle background color shift. Cards have a 1px border color change to gold or green.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure deep ink text on off-white background exceeds 4.5:1 WCAG.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must use the green accent.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden to the decorative ticker tape.

components.Hero: Deep ink/navy heading. A stylized, non-cliché candlestick chart visual (built with Framer Motion or pure SVG/CSS) integrated into the layout. A scrolling ticker tape at the bottom or top of the hero using react-fast-marquee.
components.ValueProps: 4 bento-style cards. Clean iconography (lucide-react). Monospace numbering (01, 02).
components.PricingCards: Editorial table/card hybrid. Online vs Offline. Emphasize the ₹49,000 and ₹99,000 in IBM Plex Mono. Use the gold/amber accent for the 'Most Popular' or 'Offline' highlights.
components.MentorProfile: Editorial magazine layout. Image of the mentor, deep serif quote, clean sans body.
components.BuyCourseFlow: Clean, distraction-free checkout interface mimicking a hosted gateway. Form uses HTML/Tailwind inputs customized to remove the default look (sharp corners, ink borders).

image_urls.description: Subtle off-white paper canvas texture to layer under the background with low opacity.
Professional practitioner mentor portrait (Man in gray suit holding notebook).

3d_libraries.strategy: No 3D needed. Focus on 2D motion graphics (Framer Motion) for the candlestick chart to maintain the flat, editorial print design aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set the Tailwind config to include the fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Manrope', 'IBM Plex Mono'. Fetch these from Google Fonts in your index.css
Implement the 'Swiss High-Contrast' archetype but softened with the warm off-white (#F7F5F2) and deep ink (#0B1021) colors. DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe styles.

The Hero MUST contain an animated candlestick chart constructed using div/svg and Framer Motion. DO NOT make it look like a typical dark terminal. Use the off-white background with crisp green and red candlesticks.
Use react-fast-marquee for a live-style scrolling ticker tape (e.g. NIFTY 50 ▲ 22,453.20 | BANKNIFTY ▼ 48,123.50).
In the pricing section, format the prices cleanly (₹49,000) using the monospace font and highlight with gold/amber.
Risk disclosure footer must be muted, monospace, and explicitly state that this is education, not investment advice.
For the Buy Course page, create a hosted checkout redirect feel. Remove header navigation elements on this page to maximize conversion focus.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Padding sizes should jump from p-8 to p-16 to p-24.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT heavy drop shadows. Use 1px borders for the editorial look.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
